company.shortDescription: Laurent & Laurence designs narrative branding and interior architecture for high-end independent hotels and restaurants.
company.description: Laurent & Laurence designs narrative branding and interior architecture for hospitality businesses. The company defines narrative, sensory, and architectural identities for high-end independent hotels and restaurants. Its services combine brand strategy, visual identity, and storytelling with interior design to create coherent guest experiences. Laurent & Laurence works on concept creation, renovation projects, and repositioning for hotel, restaurant, and wellness spaces. The studio focuses on aligning brand stories with spatial design to shape perception, atmosphere, and use. It supports clients from initial concept through design development to implementation guidance.
